tasks.design: Configure current committee-paper links in {DOCS}/{PROJECT} and draft only actually assigned follow-up from real working notes. Retain deliberation, substantive decisions and full meaning checks; ordinary shared-workspace saving is ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee paper navigation and descriptive follow-up typing can repeat.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: committee-source links and bounded working-note drafting can assist actual assigned follow-up.

assumptions: Provisional source10 removes two locating points; follow-up15 removes three descriptive typing points. Actual note capture is counted in70, not a free transcript. Actual paper owners supply mandate/revision and scientist records real choices and dissent; missing decisions are clarified manually.

Follow-up is conditional on actual assignment; remove/reweight if not owned. Shared internal workspace is the actual follow-up route here, not an invented email send or new committee approval job. Ordinary saves stay fully retained; existing links/drafting get zero credit.

tasks.design: Map already verified compatible series into the distinct forecast analysis dataset in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Retain source capture and verification, period/category choices, all forecast modelling and interpretation, and actual written qualifications; ordinary saving stays ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Series can be transferred and joined manually between source tables and forecast analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic joins can remove genuine repeated data assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Political regime changes, confounding and uncertainty need actual scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognizes that a structural political change invalidates a historically fitted relationship.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned deterministic joins can assemble verified forecast inputs without automating forecasts.

assumptions: Provisional assembly25 is actual manual second-dataset transfer/join work, not solver runtime or same-system saving. Source owners supply actual series ids, periods, revisions, units and definitions; scientist obtains/extracts and verifies within20 and chooses mappings. Missing definitions and breaks stay manual.

Approach20, full forecast input validation/modelling25 and actual writing/check10 remain. No synthetic respondents, generated political data or autonomous prediction is proposed. Existing joins/imports get zero credit. No public forecast publication send is assumed.
unknowns: Which series joins remain actual manual work?
research_questions: Can joins stop on changed definitions and revised period coverage?

incremental.description: Maintain series mappings and inspect definition/revision exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 actual manual series-assembly points minus1.5 upkeep=23.5. Low: changed category definitions and structural breaks need manual reconciliation, leaving only5 unchanged compatible-series join points removable, minus1.5=3.5. Data verification, modelling, interpretation and actual forecast writing remain.

tasks.design: Configure only human-chosen descriptive calculations and table generation in {SPREADSHEET}. Retain actual evidence verification, evaluation design, causal and institutional judgement, and complete written recommendations in {DOCS}; ordinary internal saving stays ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chosen descriptive comparisons and tables can be computed manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native checked formulas can compute defined descriptive measures.
tasks.still_hard: Causal inference, competing goals and suitable recommendations require actual scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist distinguishes an improved outcome from evidence that the program caused it.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: defined descriptive program comparisons can use native checked formulas while causal evaluation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional compute15 is actual manual descriptive arithmetic/table assembly. Program owner supplies actual units, periods, denominators and outcome definitions; scientist obtains/extracts and verifies within25 and chooses methods25. Missing or noncomparable outcomes stay manual; no free clean dataset.

All interpretation25 and actual recommendation writing/check10 remain. No automated policy rating, causal finding or institutional decision is proposed. Existing formulas get zero credit. Actual account is internal preparation here; no extra send or author self-approval of saving is invented.
unknowns: Which descriptive comparisons are still performed manually?
research_questions: Can calculations stop on incompatible outcome definitions and periods?
